page.content:
First sergeant and field commander of the Joe team.

How Duke connects

  • Faction: G.I. Joe team — Duke is the field commander of the G.I. Joe team.
  • Character: Cobra Commander — Duke's field command is aimed at Cobra Commander.
  • Series: G.I. Joe (Sunbow series) — Duke is the on-screen field leader of the Sunbow G.I. Joe series.

What is Duke?

Duke is Conrad S. Hauser, the blond first sergeant who leads Joes in the field, argues with Hawk on paper, and became the cartoon's on-screen captain of A Real American Hero.

Key threads lead to G.I. Joe team, Cobra Commander and G.I. Joe (Sunbow series).
